🔬 Recommended Digital Microscope (Alternative to mine): https://amzn.to/4f33Bsv

Can a pocket sanitizer really save you from millions of invisible monsters? 🧐 Or is it just clever marketing? Today on Under Microscope, we’re putting hand sanitizers to the ultimate test!

We’re comparing a 75% alcohol mix with a "molecular drill" (Benzalkonium chloride) against a brutal 96% alcohol and peroxide cocktail. 🧪 Watch as we uncover the secrets of bacterial "superhero mode" — the cysts — and see if any microbe can survive this chemical bath.

Plus, a rare, heart-breaking moment caught on camera: a Vorticella protozoa dividing... and a microscopic tragedy involving a "hydraulic press" effect. 🔬💔

Don't forget to LIKE, COMMENT, and SUBSCRIBE for more incredible journeys into the micro-world! 🔔

In this video:
00:00 — Can sanitizers really protect you?
01:27 — Meet the "Heavyweights": Testing 2 different formulas
02:36 — Experiment 1: The "Molecular Drill" in action
03:18 — What are Cysts? The secret survival mode
05:47 — Experiment 2: 96% Alcohol vs Microbes
06:14 — What is Brownian motion?
06:51 — Rare Footage: Vorticella dividing (and a tragedy)
09:54 — Testing Alcohol Wipes: Do they actually work?
11:43 — The Final Verdict: Why dosage matters
